observationsNotFindings: signed-index-trust-contract.v14's own residual sentence says 'the product-stage scope term of this artifact'. The draft substitutes the lineage name for that deictic when quoting it. The substitution changes words to preserve meaning across the artifact boundary and is the correct handling; recording it here so a later reader does not mistake the difference for a misquotation.

Only docs/v2/architecture/08-decision-and-readiness-register.md carries the pinned digest; docs/coop/architecture/08-surfaces-and-topology.md is a same-numbered file in a different tree. The prompt's digest pin resolves the collision. A reviewer who matched on path shape alone could measure the wrong file and wrongly OBJECT.

The Codex Stage A observation on G08 occupancy v7 records that CLAUDE-G08H-V6-M1 landed at v7. The draft names the signed-index-trust-contract landings (CLAUDE-V13-M1, CLAUDE-V13-S1) but does not name that G08 landing. The draft makes no completeness claim about landed prior identifiers, so this is not a defect; noting it in case a later entry wants the G08 landing recited for symmetry.

The four lineages in play sit at unrelated version numbers at draft time: signed-index-trust-contract v8, signed-index leftover-join v4, g08 leftover-join v5, G08 occupancy v3. The draft's explicit 'different lineages; their version numbers are unrelated' sentence is doing real work rather than being boilerplate.

Both Codex Stage A reviews independently pin file08Sha256 = e503b75b..., the same value measured live now. That is cross-party corroboration at a different time that file 08 has not moved, which is stronger than a single live measurement.

All three subjects carry reviewStatus AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW in their own bytes while the draft records completed dual ACCEPT. The field is the artifact's self-description frozen at authoring time and is not updated by the recording act; it is consistent with CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED and does not contradict the Stage A verdicts, which are carried by the six separate review files.

conclusion: Independent adversarial review of the D-309 draft against its own bytes and the live tree. Subject digest de9bf83c... matched at open and at verdict write, mode 0444 throughout; the subject did not move. All 13 path+digest pairs the draft asserts recompute exactly, and each Stage A review's custody nodes show it reviewed the same bytes D-309 records, so the dual ACCEPT 0/0 attaches to the recorded artifacts. All six disposition rows are exact, including the per-reviewer asymmetries between an absent field and a present-but-empty list. Every one of the ten named attacks fails against the bytes. Register tokens are preserved unflattened (DR-112 OPEN, DR-G08 OPEN, DR-118 DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED, DR-107 PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW), required-now stays 28, and the two closing sections are verbatim adopted house form. No MUST-FIX and no SHOULD-FIX survive verification.
